title: Headless TTW A Meeting of the Minds (DLC04MQ05b, the jammer destroyed): from Desmond's anger at the lighthouse, talked down, through Calvert's lab to the Brain's pod destroyed (stage 200, quest completed)

actions.text: Given: the player out of Vault 101 (MQ01 10) and Point Lookout's quests done up to Thought Control with the jammer destroyed for the Brain (DLC04MQ01 to MQ03 200 by their chains; DLC04MQ04 by its trash-compactor ending, 101 then 200, PlayerDestroyedJammer 1). DLC04MQ04's stage 200 (its second entry, the jammer destroyed) sets DLC04MQ05b 10 [observed]; done here directly so this chain runs alone. Stage 10 puts Desmond at the lighthouse with the lab's access card [observed]. The player stands on Point Lookout's landing.

Path (Desmond's betrayal forgiven): the lighthouse's door (DLC04LighthouseDoorSCRIPT: stage 50, Desmond waiting), Desmond's anger talked down (DLC04DesmondSt50Greeting2, 2a: 100, the two go after the Brain together), Calvert's lab and the Brain's chamber (DLC04MQ05DoorTrigger01SCRIPT, 02), and the Brain's pod destroyed (DLC04TheBrainScript: 185 while MQ05b runs and 150 is not done; 185 sets 200). The other choices: Desmond fought at the lighthouse or killed for the Brain (125, 150, 201).
Travel stand-in: to the lighthouse; its door (DLC04LighthouseDoorSCRIPT [observed]) sets 50 as the player goes in.

Travel stand-in: through the lighthouse's secret door and Calvert's lab to the Brain's chamber, Desmond along (the AI's follow); the player and Desmond enter its triggers (DLC04MQ05DoorTrigger01SCRIPT, 02) [observed].

Stand-in for the fight: the player shoots the Brain's pod (DLC04TheBrain DEST: health 300, seven stages); headless the shots are DamageObject for its whole health. The runner's GetDestructionStage gives the last stage's index (6) where DLC04TheBrainScript waits for 7 (the DSTD damage stages run 1 to 7) [observed], so the burst step's own variables are set as it sets them (destroyonce 1, explode 1, timer 5); the script's countdown then sets 185 (MQ05b running, 150 not done), and 185 sets 200 [observed].

actions.label: the pod's destruction stage (6: the last index)
